question: Is there really a secret Taylor Swift video game breaking the internet?
story: There is apparently a secret Taylor Swift video game floating around online, and people are absolutely losing it trying to beat the thing. The rules sound simple. You have to clear every single era, from the very first album all the way to the newest one, without missing a single beat. Sounds easy, until you reach the Red level, where players say the game suddenly speeds up so fast that almost nobody survives it. The rumor is that the final stage is a ten minute mega mix that reshuffles every time you play, so you can never memorize the pattern. One streamer claims he stayed up until four in the morning and still could not clear the Reputation level. And here is the wildest part. Supposedly, whoever beats the whole game first unlocks a hidden song that has never been released. Real, or the greatest fan hoax of all time? Either way, the internet cannot stop playing.
